payload.title: MPT Core Length Comparison
payload.summary: This Jupyter notebook analyzes the core length and timing of the Mid-Pleistocene Transition (MPT) using isotopic data. It imports and processes datasets from PANGAEA and other sources to compare core lengths and isotopic variations across different ocean drilling sites. The notebook utilizes various Python libraries for data manipulation, visualization, and analysis. Outputs include plots of isotopic data over time, highlighting discontinuities and variations in core samples.
goals: Compare core lengths during the Mid-Pleistocene Transition.
Analyze isotopic variations across different ocean drilling sites.

section_blurbs.blurb: This section introduces the comparison of core lengths during the Mid-Pleistocene Transition using isotopic data from the PANGAEA dataset. It sets up the environment by importing necessary libraries and suppressing warnings for presentation purposes.
section_blurbs.heading: MPT Core Length Comparison

section_blurbs.blurb: This section defines group lists for loading isotopic data from various ocean drilling sites. It processes the data to exclude discontinuities and prepares it for analysis and visualization.

section_blurbs.blurb: Similar to the previous section, this part focuses on slicing the isotopic data for specific time intervals, ensuring that discontinuities are managed appropriately for accurate analysis.
